n1.text: Image first. The cover image decides the technique (LSB for PNG/BMP, EXIF for JPEG/TIFF) and how much text fits, so it leads the flow and drives a live capacity meter.

n2.text: No silent failures. Each error sits next to the field that caused it, and the action button stays disabled until the form is valid. The 2-second status bar goes away.

n3.text: Encryption is an explicit, labelled switch (on by default) instead of an unlabelled checkbox. Plain mode shows a persistent inline warning instead of a blocking modal.

n4.text: Cross-platform: Qt Fusion style + one QSS theme with light/dark tokens, bundled SVG icons (no emoji), follows the OS colour scheme, native file dialogs, Ctrl/⌘+Enter runs the action.

n5.text: Switching Hide ⇄ Reveal keeps the chosen image (you often reveal right after hiding to check it) and only clears the mode-specific fields.
